zh-TW.game.sudoku.desc: 在 9×9 方格中，找出每個數字的位置。
zh-TW.sudoku.title: 經典數獨
zh-TW.sudoku.subtitle: 單人・邏輯
zh-TW.sudoku.rules: 在空格填入 1–9，讓每列、每行與每個 3×3 宮的數字都不重複。題目數字不能更改。
zh-TW.sudoku.rules.short: 每列、每行、每宮，1–9 不重複
zh-TW.sudoku.easy.desc: 從單一候選與唯一位置開始。
zh-TW.sudoku.medium.desc: 練習候選排除與數字配對。
zh-TW.sudoku.notes.help: 點數字可加入或移除候選筆記。筆記不算填答。
zh-TW.sudoku.notes.filled: 先清除填答，才能在這一格做筆記。
zh-TW.sudoku.hint.title: 下一步的線索
zh-TW.sudoku.hint.conflict: 先處理重複的數字，再取得下一步提示。
zh-TW.sudoku.hint.contradiction: 第 {row} 列第 {column} 行的填答，使這一題無法完成。你可以清除後重新推理。
zh-TW.sudoku.hint.unavailable: 暫時無法提供下一步提示。進度已保留，請再試一次。
zh-TW.sudoku.hint.nakedSingle: 排除同列、同行與同宮已出現的數字後，第 {row} 列第 {column} 行只剩 {digit} 可以填。
zh-TW.sudoku.hint.hiddenSingle: {unit}中，只有第 {row} 列第 {column} 行能填入 {digit}。
zh-TW.sudoku.hint.locked: {sourceUnit}中的 {digit} 只能出現在{cells}，因此可從{targetCells}排除 {digit}。
zh-TW.sudoku.hint.nakedPair: {unit}中的{cells}都只剩 {digits}，這兩個數字必須占據這兩格，可從{targetCells}排除。
zh-TW.sudoku.hint.hiddenPair: {unit}中的 {digits} 都只能出現在{cells}，因此這兩格可移除其他候選。
zh-TW.sudoku.hint.xwing: {sourceUnits}中的 {digit} 都只能落在{crossUnits}的交點，因此可從{targetCells}排除 {digit}。
zh-TW.sudoku.paused.title: 休息一下
zh-TW.sudoku.selection: 第 {row} 列 · 第 {column} 行
zh-TW.sudoku.given.locked: 這是題目數字，請選擇空白格。
zh-TW.sudoku.conflict: 有數字重複，請查看標示的格子。
zh-TW.sudoku.restart.title: 重新開始這一題？
zh-TW.sudoku.restart.desc: 填答、筆記與計時將重新開始，完成紀錄會標記為重玩。
zh-TW.sudoku.new.title: 開始新的一題？
zh-TW.sudoku.new.desc: 目前這一局的進度會被取代。
zh-TW.sudoku.save.failed: 無法儲存，離開後可能遺失進度。
zh-TW.sudoku.save.invalid: 無法讀取這份進度。原始資料已保留，你可以開始新遊戲。
zh-TW.sudoku.otherTab: 這一局已在另一個分頁開啟，這裡已暫停。
zh-TW.sudoku.history.local: 紀錄只儲存在此瀏覽器，不會同步到其他裝置。
zh-TW.sudoku.teach.row: 每一列都要有 1–9，而且不能重複。
zh-TW.sudoku.teach.box: 每個粗線框出的 3×3 宮，都要有 1–9。
zh-TW.sudoku.teach.single: 看看同列、同行與同宮，找出這一格唯一能填的數字。
zh-TW.sudoku.teach.notes: 還不確定時，開啟筆記記下候選；需要幫忙時，提示會解釋下一步。
zh-TW.sudoku.teach.retry: 再看看相關的列、行與九宮。
zh-TW.sudoku.a11y.cell: 第 {row} 列，第 {column} 行，第 {box} 宮；{content}；{state}

en.game.sudoku.desc: Find the place for every number in a 9×9 grid.
en.sudoku.title: Classic Sudoku
en.sudoku.subtitle: Single player · Logic
en.sudoku.rules: Fill empty cells with 1–9 so that each row, column, and 3×3 box contains no repeated numbers. Given numbers cannot be changed.
en.sudoku.rules.short: Every row, column, and box: 1–9, with no repeats
en.sudoku.easy.desc: Start with naked and hidden singles.
en.sudoku.hard.desc: Try hidden pairs and X-Wing patterns.
en.sudoku.notes.help: Tap a number to add or remove a candidate. Notes do not count as answers.
en.sudoku.notes.filled: Erase the answer before adding notes to this cell.
en.sudoku.hint.title: A clue for your next step
en.sudoku.hint.conflict: Resolve the repeated numbers before requesting a hint.
en.sudoku.hint.contradiction: The answer in row {row}, column {column} makes this puzzle impossible to complete. Try erasing it and working through the clues again.
en.sudoku.hint.unavailable: A hint is temporarily unavailable. Your progress is safe. Please try again.
en.sudoku.hint.nakedSingle: After excluding numbers in the same row, column, and box, only {digit} can go in row {row}, column {column}.
en.sudoku.hint.hiddenSingle: In {unit}, only row {row}, column {column} can contain {digit}.
en.sudoku.hint.locked: In {sourceUnit}, {digit} can only appear in {cells}, so it can be removed from {targetCells}.
en.sudoku.hint.nakedPair: In {unit}, {cells} each have only {digits} as candidates. Those numbers occupy these two cells and can be removed from {targetCells}.
en.sudoku.hint.hiddenPair: In {unit}, {digits} can only appear in {cells}, so all other candidates can be removed from those two cells.
en.sudoku.hint.xwing: In {sourceUnits}, {digit} can only occupy the intersections with {crossUnits}, so it can be removed from {targetCells}.
en.sudoku.paused.title: Take a break
en.sudoku.paused.desc: The board and timer are paused
en.sudoku.select.help: Select a cell, then enter a number.
en.sudoku.given.locked: This number is given. Please choose an empty cell.
en.sudoku.conflict: A number is repeated. Check the marked cells.
en.sudoku.restart.title: Restart this puzzle?
en.sudoku.restart.desc: Your answers, notes, and timer will reset. The completed game will be marked as a replay.
en.sudoku.new.title: Start a new puzzle?
en.sudoku.new.desc: Your current game will be replaced.
en.sudoku.save.failed: Unable to save. Your progress may be lost if you leave.
en.sudoku.save.invalid: This saved game could not be loaded. The original data has been kept. You can start a new game.
en.sudoku.otherTab: This game is open in another tab. Play is paused here.
en.sudoku.history.local: Records are stored only in this browser and do not sync to other devices.
en.sudoku.teach.row: Every row must contain 1–9, with no repeats.
en.sudoku.teach.column: Every vertical column must also contain 1–9.
en.sudoku.teach.box: Each 3×3 box outlined by bold lines must contain 1–9.
en.sudoku.teach.single: Check the row, column, and box to find the only number that fits this cell.
en.sudoku.teach.notes: Use Notes to track candidates. When you need help, a hint explains the next step.
en.sudoku.teach.success: That's right. Continue to the next step.
en.sudoku.teach.retry: Check the related row, column, and box again.
